Get the Swiss Cantons

Source: R/kanton.R
kanton.Rd

Returns the 26 Swiss cantons with their official BFS number, abbreviation and name in German, French and Italian. Use it to label cantonal results or to translate between the numeric code and the abbreviation.

Usage

kanton()

Value

A data.frame with the columns kanton_id, kanton_c, kanton_x_de, kanton_x_fr and kanton_x_it.

Details

The table is shipped with the package; the cantonal numbering has been stable since the founding of the canton of Jura in 1979.

See also

geoKanton().

Other swiss.register: gemeinde(), gemeindeMutationen(), praemienregion(), raumgliederung()
